name: wren3270-bridge-windows-build
description: Pruned install manifest for the Windows portable build. Installed into a separate node_modules (npm ci --prefix build-windows/install) before the esbuild bundle step, so kerberos's node-gyp build (needs krb5-dev, unavailable off Alpine/Linux) is never attempted. kerberos and ldapts are only consumed by auth/windows-auth.js, which nothing else in the app imports (see that file's own header comment) — dead code today, excluded here rather than fixed.
